what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Lebanon.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 532357 Syrian refugees in Lebanon, 10.9% of all Syrian refugees.
Türkiye and Germany host more; Jordan and Iraq host fewer.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, with Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011 to 2020 and in 2023 and 2024.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025, and over Rojava Kurdistan territory with the PYD from 2012 to 2015.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2024, after big changes between 2011 and 2013.
UNHCR's figure for Lebanon peaked at 1147494 in 2014 and fell to 532357 by 2025.
Returns from Lebanon to Syria were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Lebanon only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
People displaced inside Syria are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Lebanon they live.
